_meta.source: NEC Chapter 9, Table 8 (Conductor Properties) - conductor area in circular mils.
_meta.caveat: The 13 AWG values (14 through 4/0) are printed digits and were verified 2026-07-19 against primary reproductions of the 2017 NEC table text plus Southwire and Okonite engineering handbooks, zero discrepancies. For kcmil-named sizes the NEC prints a dash in the circular-mil column - the size name IS the area - so those entries are definitional (kcmil x 1000), not transcriptions.
_meta.notes: Relocated 2026-07-19 out of nec_ch9_table9.json (same verified values) so one file owns one table, and extended past 1000 kcmil: Table 8 lists 700/800/900/1250/1500/1750/2000 kcmil even though Table 9 does not. Used by the voltage-drop K-factor method and by the NEC 250.122(B) proportional EGC increase.
